response.sql:
WITH signal_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    telescref,
    COUNT(*) as signal_count
  FROM signals
  GROUP BY telescref
),
with_fractions AS (
  SELECT 
    telescref,
    signal_count,
    CAST(signal_count AS FLOAT) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM signals) as fraction,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY signal_count DESC) as row_num
  FROM signal_counts
)
SELECT 
  telescref,
  signal_count,
  fraction
FROM with_fractions
WHERE signal_count >= (
  SELECT signal_count FROM with_fractions WHERE row_num = 10
)
ORDER BY fraction DESC;

alternatives.interpretation: Using DENSE_RANK() to include all value groups within the top 10 ranks (rather than all rows tied with position 10). This treats "top 10" as the top 10 distinct signal-count values, and could return significantly more than 10 rows if many telescopes tie at early ranks.
alternatives.sql:
WITH signal_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    telescref,
    COUNT(*) as signal_count
  FROM signals
  GROUP BY telescref
),
with_fractions AS (
  SELECT 
    telescref,
    signal_count,
    CAST(signal_count AS FLOAT) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM signals) as fraction,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY signal_count DESC) as dense_rank
  FROM signal_counts
)
SELECT 
  telescref,
  signal_count,
  fraction
FROM with_fractions
WHERE dense_rank <= 10
ORDER BY fraction DESC;
